description: Lists the operations (steps) that make up flows, optionally narrowed to one flow with flow_id. Use get_flow with include_operations for the whole pipeline of a single flow, and this tool to scan across flows, for example to find every step of a given type. Read-only: listing an operation never runs it. Returns at most 50 operations unless limit says otherwise, each with its key, type, editor position and options.
name: get_operations
